report:
Applied the advisor's two round-1 revision points to bench/spec_summarize.py: (1) vram_by_phase() now parses per-phase memory.used from vram.txt and rule 4 reports all per-phase deltas (A-prod: single-agent +1, single-mem +1, dual-agent +1, dual-mem -1 MiB; max +1 MiB, still PASS) instead of one flat arm median; (2) the off dual-vs-single control now records first-divergence character indices for every mismatched pair into both summary.md (new column) and summary.json ("mismatches" lists per role). Added a one-line completion print.

Verified via smoke test in /tmp against the real replay data: all perf rows unchanged, rule verdicts unchanged (1,4,6 pass; 2,3,5 fail), deploy.json = {"deployed": false, "why": [rule 2, rule 3, rule 5]}. The only values the sandbox cannot fill are the divergence indices, because bench/.replay (gitignored) is absent from the sandbox — those come from the host run.

The script change is on disk (bench/spec_summarize.py, py_compile OK, diff reviewed); the host run will also regenerate bench/results/2026-10-12/m1-ngram/summary.md, summary.json, deploy.json.
why: Regenerate the summary artifacts on the host where bench/.replay/m1/outputs/ (gitignored hashed outputs) exists, so the new control first-divergence indices are real. Reads only bench/ files, writes only under bench/results/; no llama-server, no GPU.
